title: acp_thread: Emit elicitation completion from state transitions
body:
Emit elicitation completion from the authoritative state transition rather than from the task awaiting its response.

ACP request cancellation can drop the response task before canceling the stored elicitation. Previously, the request became canceled but never emitted `ElicitationResponded`. A regression reproduces the consequence: idle-sleep prevention stays disabled even though the request is no longer pending and the agent is still generating.

- Make response tasks receiver-only; emit completion from the owning session thread or connection store.
- Distinguish resolving a pending request from canceling an already-accepted URL flow, which must not emit a second response.
- Preserve existing response payloads, update-before-completion event order, and duplicate/no-op behavior.

Release Notes:

- N/A
